title: Nihongo con Teppei for Beginners — 天気の話 (Talking About Weather)
description: From Nihongo con Teppei for Beginners — a podcast/YouTube series where host Teppei speaks slowly and naturally about everyday topics in Japanese, designed for immersion learners. This episode covers weather expressions, seasonal weather in Japan, and how Japanese people use weather as small talk.
